reply: Maazrat, Mobile Zone par mobile phones nahi bikte. Hamare paas chargers, cables, earbuds, power banks aur phone covers milte hain.

customer: type c cable le rha hun agar 2 mahine me kharab ho gayi to warranty milegi na??

customer: AoA karachi delivery krte ho? charges kitne

customer: easypaisa se payment ho jaye gi ya sirf cash on delivery hai

customer: order 77412 wale earbuds ka left side band ho gaya hai 1 month me hi. claim kaise karna hai plz batao

customer: power bank pani me gir gaya tha ab charge nhi ho raha, warranty me thk ho jaye ga?
reply: Maazrat, warranty mein physical ya water damage cover nahi hota, is liye yeh claim warranty mein nahi aayega.

customer: power bank pe bhi warranty hai ya sirf earbuds pe? aur claim me kitne din lagte

customer: what all do u guys sell? smart watches too?
